'''Styanax lance''' was a type of [[Harpoon/Legends|harpoon]] used by [[stabmen]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to hunt the [[styanax]], an aquatic predatory native to the [[Sea of Jarad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]].<ref name="SoF" />
